description: Engagement data store for the Cantab Pi agentic consulting environment. Single source of truth for tables, fields, render contracts, views, placeholders and agent write scopes.

conventions.id_pattern: <prefix>-<2 or 3 digits>, e.g. tk-07; ids are assigned by the tool on create and never change
conventions.money: Amounts in the engagement currency; value tables are in millions (€m) unless the field says otherwise
conventions.text: Plain text only. No markup. Line breaks (\n) only where the field allows more than one line
conventions.meta: Every record carries _meta {version, updated_at, updated_by, reason}, set by the tool only
conventions.order: Order and number fields are renumbered 1..n by the tool after each write, preserving relative order

engagement.description: The engagement itself. Exactly one record.

as_of.description: Demo 'today'. All status, slippage and week calculations use this date

people.description: Consulting team members and client stakeholders.

rate_day.description: Day rate in engagement currency. Consulting only

capacity_days_week.description: Days per week available to the engagement. Consulting only

milestones.description: Dated checkpoints such as kick-off, go-live, SteerCo or board decisions.

deliverables.description: Work products the team commits to.

milestone_id.description: Milestone the deliverable feeds, if any

tasks.description: Scheduled work items shown on the Gantt chart.

raci.description: RACI assignment of one person to one deliverable.

phase_raci.description: Role and one-line responsibility of each person in each phase.

comment.description: One sentence: what this person does in the phase

time_entries.description: Planned and actual days per consulting team member per engagement week. Complete grid: every consulting person has one record per week.

actual_days.description: Required for weeks before the as-of week, empty from the as-of week on

actions.description: Recommended actions raised by the project manager and team manager agents.

person_id.description: Person the action is about, if any

issue_nodes.description: Issue tree: one key question, 2-5 branches, 1-5 hypotheses per branch.

answer.description: Branches only: the key-line statement for the storyline

analysis.description: Hypotheses only: the analysis that tests it

sources.description: Research sources used by the analyst.

url.description: Link, if the source is public

findings.description: Evidence linking a source to a hypothesis.

quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the source, shown on hover

value_steps.description: Bars of the value bridge, left to right.

label.description: Category label; \n forces a line break

value.description: Absolute for start, signed change for delta, empty for subtotal (derived)

model_cell_id.description: Model cell the value comes from

value_settings.description: Settings for the value view. Exactly one record.

npv_base.description: Base-case NPV used by the sensitivity chart

npv_cell_id.description: Model output the NPV comes from

annotation_from_id.description: Bridge bracket start (a start or subtotal step)

annotation_to_id.description: Bridge bracket end (a later subtotal step)

sensitivity_drivers.description: Tornado chart inputs: output value at the downside and upside value of one input.

downside_input.description: Displayed input value that gives the lower output

model_cells.description: Business-case spreadsheet. Each record is one row of a sheet: label in column B, value in column C (the ref), unit in D, formula or note in E.

ref.description: Value cell, C4 to C59; the row number orders the sheet

formula.description: Calc and output rows only; references as Sheet!C7 or C7

narratives.description: Text blocks on views: titles, eyebrows, footnotes, so-what points. Slots are defined below; fixed slots always exist.

text.description: Length limit per slot is set in slots

deck.description: The current deck. Exactly one record.

pdf_url.description: Relative path or https URL of the PDF

slides.description: Slides of the deck, with their action titles and link to the storyline.

proposal.description: Letter of proposal header. Exactly one record.

proposal_sections.description: Sections of the letter of proposal. The seven keys are fixed.

proposal_staffing.description: Consultant days proposed per team member; fees are derived from day rates.

skills.description: Catalogue of skills available to agents.

agents.description: Agent setups: goal, system prompt, trigger and assigned skills.

audience.description: team = an agent for the consulting team; client = an agent built for the client

agent_lines.description: List blocks of an agent setup: tools (with data access), state variables and guardrails.

resource.description: Tools only: system or table the tool touches

invariants.rule: engagement.start < engagement.end and start <= as_of <= end; start is a Monday
partner_id and manager_id are consulting people; sponsor_id is a client person
Consulting people have rate_day and capacity_days_week; client people have neither
Phases ordered 1..n do not overlap, each start <= end, the first starts on engagement.start and the last ends on engagement.end
Every date field lies within [engagement.start, engagement.end]
A milestone date lies within its phase
status done or missed requires date <= as_of
Owner is consulting; due lies within the phase; if milestone_id is set the milestone is in the same phase and due <= milestone date; status late requires due < as_of
Owner is consulting; start <= end; start and end lie within the phase; deliverable (if set) is in the same phase

Status vs as_of and progress: done requires progress 100 and end <= as_of; not_started requires progress 0 and start > as_of; in_progress, at_risk and late require start <= as_of and progress < 100; late requires end < as_of
depends_on contains no self-reference and the dependency graph has no cycles
One role per (deliverable, person); every deliverable has exactly one A and at least one R; the deliverable owner holds R or A
Exactly one record per consulting person per engagement week (complete grid); week <= number of engagement weeks; actual_days present for weeks before the as-of week and empty from the as-of week on
Per deliverable, cycles run 1..n in date order; review dates are <= as_of

Exactly one question (no parent); branches have the question as parent (2-5 branches); hypotheses have a branch as parent (1-5 per branch); answer is required on branches and absent elsewhere; status and analysis are required on hypotheses and absent elsewhere
findings.hypothesis_id and value_steps.hypothesis_id point to hypothesis nodes
Bridge shape: the first step is the only start; the last step is a subtotal; start and delta steps have a value, subtotals do not; deltas are non-zero; the running level stays >= 0
Annotation (if set): both ends set, from is a start or subtotal, to is a later subtotal
downside_value <= npv_base <= upside_value and downside_value < upside_value
ref unique per sheet; calc and output rows have a formula, input rows do not; every reference in a formula resolves to an existing cell
Slot rules: slot exists for the view; fixed slots present exactly once; group slots within min..max; highlight only where highlight_max allows and within it; text within the slot's max_len
Placeholders {name} must be declared by the view; for length checks each placeholder counts as its declared width
Slide numbers run 1..n without gaps or duplicates
Tools lines have access and resource and no type or value; state lines have type (value optional) and no access or resource; guardrail lines have none of access, resource, type or value
Each section key exists exactly once; staffing persons are consulting and unique; addressee is a client person
Record ids are unique, match the table prefix, and fixed ids and keys are present; table cardinality within min..max; ordered fields form 1..n per group
One role per (phase, person); every phase that has phase RACI rows has exactly one A and at least one R
A start or delta step linked to a model cell has the cell's value (rounded to 1 decimal); a linked subtotal's derived level equals the cell value within 0.5
npv_base equals the linked model output (rounded)
Narrative text quotes a literal money figure (e.g. €51m); prefer a placeholder so the text cannot go stale
A task ends after its deliverable's due date, or a deliverable is due after its milestone, or a dependency ends after the dependent task starts

placeholder_formats.money_m: Currency symbol + whole millions, e.g. €51m; negative values get −. Width 8
placeholder_formats.money_k: Currency symbol + whole thousands, e.g. €894k. Width 10
placeholder_formats.text: Text from data. Width as declared
